analysis.development_selection: On the same 10 development worlds, take the arithmetic mean of per-world net throughput within each budget and then across T/M/L. Freeze one tube per model; exact ties use canonical tube name. No confirmation or flight rows enter selection.
analysis.confirmation: Retain each seed separately. Average seeds within world and method; pair methods within world, then resample whole worlds 5000 times with RNG 271828 using common indices across budgets. Report 95% intervals per prespecified comparison. No aggregate claim based on choosing a winning comparison post hoc.
analysis.amovfly: Freeze flight inclusion using metadata and observed trajectory quality before model evaluation. The primary run uses seed 7. Report paired per-flight effects, lap distributions, and session sensitivity; do not count windows as independent flights.
